0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-3, 3rd in the Atlantic and 7th in the East) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West) with both teams at .500 through six games. Toronto is 1-2 on the road and on a two-game losing streak, while Denver is 1-2 at home and has lost its last game. Toronto is without Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Raptors lost 0-2, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
